Game Overview

Dr. Rocket puts players into a action experience centered on pilot your rocket through three thrilling gameplay modes in Dr. Rocket. Master precision in launch, navigate perilous platforms, and test your endurance in endless climbing. Climb the ranks from Astronaut to Legendary Rocketman while engaging with vibrant visuals and pulse-pounding action. Are you ready for liftoff?
